name: FrankCrum
summary: FrankCrum is a PEO, founded in 1981, that lists payroll and tax, HR management, workers' compensation, employee benefits and retirement plans. Its own guide describes co-employment, benefit pooling and payroll administration. The site shows no price and offers an intro call.

facts.text: FrankCrum's guide says the PEO becomes the employer for tax and administrative purposes while the client keeps directing daily work.
The same guide gives a general industry range of roughly $40 to $160 per employee per month for administrative services, or 2% to 12% of payroll. It is not FrankCrum's own rate.
The home page does not mention IRS CPEO certification or ESAC accreditation and states no minimum headcount.

plans.name: PEO
plans.notes: The home page lists no price and offers a Request An Intro Call button
